    o.STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS,

    o.RETURNED_AT AS ORDER_RETURNED_AT,

WITH RECURSIVE date_spine (date_day, max_date) AS (

    -- 1. Get the minimum and maximum order dates
    SELECT
        MIN(TO_DATE(CREATED_AT)),
        MAX(TO_DATE(CREATED_AT))

    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.stg_orders

    WHERE CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 2. Generate consecutive calendar dates
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, 1, date_day),
        max_date

    FROM date_spine

    WHERE date_day < max_date
)

-- 3. Build the date dimension
SELECT

    -- Date Identifier
    TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(date_day, 'YYYYMMDD')) AS DATE_KEY,

    -- Full Date
    date_day AS FULL_DATE,

    -- Year Information
    YEAR(date_day) AS YEAR,
    QUARTER(date_day) AS QUARTER,
    MONTH(date_day) AS MONTH,

    -- Month Information
    MONTHNAME(date_day) AS MONTH_NAME,

    -- Week Information
    WEEKISO(date_day) AS WEEK_OF_YEAR,
    DAYOFWEEKISO(date_day) AS DAY_OF_WEEK,

    -- Day Information
    DAY(date_day) AS DAY_OF_MONTH,
    DAYOFYEAR(date_day) AS DAY_OF_YEAR,
    DAYNAME(date_day) AS DAY_NAME,

    -- Weekend Indicator
    CASE
        WHEN DAYOFWEEKISO(date_day) IN (6, 7)
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS IS_WEEKEND

FROM date_spine

WITH order_items AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.int_order_items_enriched

),

final AS (

    SELECT

        -- 1. Fact Table Identifiers
        oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID,
        oi.ORDER_ID,

        -- 2. Dimension Keys
        du.USER_ID,
        dp.PRODUCT_ID,
        dd.DATE_KEY AS ORDER_DATE_KEY,

        -- 3. Order Information
        oi.ORDER_STATUS,
        oi.ITEM_STATUS,
        oi.ORDER_CREATED_AT,

        -- 4. Product Information
        oi.PRODUCT_CATEGORY,
        oi.PRODUCT_BRAND,

        -- 5. Business Measures
        oi.SALE_PRICE AS ITEM_SALE_AMOUNT,
        oi.PRODUCT_COST AS ESTIMATED_ITEM_COST,

        1 AS ITEM_QUANTITY,

        -- 6. Estimated Gross Profit
        oi.SALE_PRICE - oi.PRODUCT_COST
            AS ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT

    FROM order_items oi

    LEFT JOIN ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.dim_users du
        ON oi.USER_ID = du.USER_ID

    LEFT JOIN ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.dim_products dp
        ON oi.PRODUCT_ID = dp.PRODUCT_ID

    LEFT JOIN ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.dim_date dd
        ON TO_DATE(oi.ORDER_CREATED_AT) = dd.FULL_DATE

)

WITH product_sales AS (

    -- 1. Aggregate sales metrics by product
    SELECT

        PRODUCT_ID,

        COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ITEM_ID)
            AS TOTAL_ORDER_ITEMS,

        SUM(ITEM_QUANTITY)
            AS TOTAL_UNITS_SOLD,

        COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID)
            AS TOTAL_ORDERS,

        COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID)
            AS TOTAL_CUSTOMERS,

        SUM(ITEM_SALE_AMOUNT)
            AS TOTAL_RECORDED_SALES,

        SUM(ESTIMATED_ITEM_COST)
            AS TOTAL_ESTIMATED_COST,

        SUM(ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT)
            AS TOTAL_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT,

        AVG(ITEM_SALE_AMOUNT)
            AS AVERAGE_SELLING_PRICE

    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.fct_order_items

    GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID

),

final AS (

    -- 2. Combine product information with sales metrics
    SELECT

        -- Product Information
        p.PRODUCT_ID,
        p.PRODUCT_NAME,
        p.PRODUCT_CATEGORY,
        p.PRODUCT_BRAND,
        p.PRODUCT_DEPARTMENT,

        p.PRODUCT_COST,
        p.PRODUCT_RETAIL_PRICE,

        p.SKU,
        p.DISTRIBUTION_CENTER_ID,

        -- Sales Metrics
        COALESCE(s.TOTAL_ORDER_ITEMS, 0)
            AS TOTAL_ORDER_ITEMS,

        COALESCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS_SOLD, 0)
            AS TOTAL_UNITS_SOLD,

        COALESCE(s.TOTAL_ORDERS, 0)
            AS TOTAL_ORDERS,

        COALESCE(s.TOTAL_CUSTOMERS, 0)
            AS TOTAL_CUSTOMERS,

        COALESCE(s.TOTAL_RECORDED_SALES, 0)
            AS TOTAL_RECORDED_SALES,

        COALESCE(s.TOTAL_ESTIMATED_COST, 0)
            AS TOTAL_ESTIMATED_COST,

        COALESCE(s.TOTAL_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT, 0)
            AS TOTAL_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT,

        s.AVERAGE_SELLING_PRICE,

        -- Estimated Gross Profit Margin
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(s.TOTAL_RECORDED_SALES, 0) = 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                s.TOTAL_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT
                / s.TOTAL_RECORDED_SALES * 100
        END AS ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN_PCT

    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.dim_products p

    LEFT JOIN product_sales s
        ON p.PRODUCT_ID = s.PRODUCT_ID

)

WITH order_items_aggregated AS (

    -- Aggregate order items to order level
    SELECT
        ORDER_ID,

        COUNT(ORDER_ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_COUNT,

        SUM(ITEM_SALE_AMOUNT) AS ORDER_SALES_AMOUNT,

        SUM(ESTIMATED_ITEM_COST) AS ORDER_ESTIMATED_COST,

        SUM(ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT)
            AS ORDER_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT

    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.fct_order_items

    GROUP BY ORDER_ID

),

final AS (

    SELECT

        -- 1. Order Identifier
        o.ORDER_ID,

        -- 2. Dimension Keys
        u.USER_ID,
        d.DATE_KEY AS ORDER_DATE_KEY,

        -- 3. Order Information
        o.STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS,
        o.GENDER AS ORDER_GENDER,
        o.CREATED_AT AS ORDER_CREATED_AT,
        o.RETURNED_AT,
        o.SHIPPED_AT,
        o.DELIVERED_AT,

        -- 4. Order Metrics
        o.NUM_OF_ITEM,
        COALESCE(i.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT,

        -- 5. Sales Metrics
        COALESCE(i.ORDER_SALES_AMOUNT, 0)
            AS ORDER_SALES_AMOUNT,

        COALESCE(i.ORDER_ESTIMATED_COST, 0)
            AS ORDER_ESTIMATED_COST,

        COALESCE(i.ORDER_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT, 0)
            AS ORDER_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT

    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.stg_orders o

    LEFT JOIN order_items_aggregated i
        ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID

    LEFT JOIN ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.dim_users u
        ON o.USER_ID = u.USER_ID

    LEFT JOIN ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.dim_date d
        ON TO_DATE(o.CREATED_AT) = d.FULL_DATE

)

WITH monthly_sales AS (

    -- 1. Aggregate sales metrics by month
    SELECT

        DATE_TRUNC(
            'MONTH',
            ORDER_CREATED_AT
        ) AS SALES_MONTH,

        COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS TOTAL_ORDERS,

        SUM(ITEM_COUNT) AS TOTAL_ITEMS,

        SUM(ORDER_SALES_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_SALES,

        SUM(ORDER_ESTIMATED_COST) AS TOTAL_ESTIMATED_COST,

        SUM(ORDER_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT)
            AS TOTAL_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT,

        AVG(ORDER_SALES_AMOUNT) AS AVERAGE_ORDER_AMOUNT

    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.fct_orders

    WHERE ORDER_CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ORDER_CREATED_AT)

),

sales_with_previous_month AS (

    -- 2. Calculate previous month's sales

    SELECT

        *,

        LAG(TOTAL_SALES) OVER (
            ORDER BY SALES_MONTH
        ) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_SALES,

        LAG(TOTAL_ORDERS) OVER (
            ORDER BY SALES_MONTH
        ) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_ORDERS,

        LAG(TOTAL_ITEMS) OVER (
            ORDER BY SALES_MONTH
        ) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_ITEMS,

        LAG(TOTAL_ESTIMATED_COST) OVER (
            ORDER BY SALES_MONTH
        ) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_ESTIMATED_COST

    FROM monthly_sales

),

final AS (

    -- 3. Calculate month-over-month growth

    SELECT

        SALES_MONTH,

        YEAR(SALES_MONTH) AS SALES_YEAR,

        MONTH(SALES_MONTH) AS SALES_MONTH_NUMBER,

        TOTAL_ORDERS,

        TOTAL_ITEMS,

        TOTAL_SALES,

        TOTAL_ESTIMATED_COST,

        TOTAL_ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT,

        AVERAGE_ORDER_AMOUNT,

        PREVIOUS_MONTH_SALES,

        PREVIOUS_MONTH_ORDERS,

        PREVIOUS_MONTH_ITEMS,

        PREVIOUS_MONTH_ESTIMATED_COST,

        CASE
            WHEN PREVIOUS_MONTH_SALES IS NULL
                OR PREVIOUS_MONTH_SALES = 0
            THEN NULL

            ELSE
                (TOTAL_SALES - PREVIOUS_MONTH_SALES)
                / PREVIOUS_MONTH_SALES * 100

        END AS SALES_MOM_GROWTH_PCT

    FROM sales_with_previous_month

)

SELECT *

WITH customer_orders AS (

    -- 1. Aggregate order metrics by customer
    SELECT

        USER_ID,

        COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID)
            AS TOTAL_ORDERS,

        SUM(ORDER_SALES_AMOUNT)
            AS TOTAL_RECORDED_SALES,

        AVG(ORDER_SALES_AMOUNT)
            AS AVERAGE_ORDER_AMOUNT,

        MIN(TO_DATE(ORDER_CREATED_AT))
            AS FIRST_ORDER_DATE,

        MAX(TO_DATE(ORDER_CREATED_AT))
            AS LAST_ORDER_DATE

    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.fct_orders

    WHERE USER_ID IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY USER_ID

),

final AS (

    -- 2. Combine customer profile and order metrics
    SELECT

        -- Customer Information
        u.USER_ID,

        u.FIRST_NAME,
        u.LAST_NAME,
        u.EMAIL,

        u.AGE,
        u.GENDER,

        u.STATE,
        u.CITY,
        u.COUNTRY,

        u.TRAFFIC_SOURCE,
        u.CREATED_AT AS USER_CREATED_AT,

        -- Customer Order Metrics
        COALESCE(o.TOTAL_ORDERS, 0)
            AS TOTAL_ORDERS,

        COALESCE(o.TOTAL_RECORDED_SALES, 0)
            AS TOTAL_RECORDED_SALES,

        o.AVERAGE_ORDER_AMOUNT,

        o.FIRST_ORDER_DATE,
        o.LAST_ORDER_DATE,

        -- Repeat Customer Flag
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(o.TOTAL_ORDERS, 0) >= 2
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS IS_REPEAT_CUSTOMER,

        -- Customer Purchase Behavior
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(o.TOTAL_ORDERS, 0) = 0
                THEN 'NEVER_PURCHASED'

            WHEN o.TOTAL_ORDERS = 1
                THEN 'ONE_TIME_CUSTOMER'

            ELSE 'REPEAT_CUSTOMER'
        END AS CUSTOMER_SEGMENT

    FROM ECOM_RAW.ANALYTICS_DEV.dim_users u

    LEFT JOIN customer_orders o
        ON u.USER_ID = o.USER_ID

)

SELECT *
FROM final
